sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 3x Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Bodycam, 2x Radio.
Arrived at the office; debriefing with night shift then gearing up to patrol.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square with welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks and Queen St McDonald's all clear; Localito and 77 Convenience stores have just opened. Continuing to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a sweep.
Heading towards Federal St via Wellesley St.
Arrived at corner of Victoria and Federal St; welfare checks completed on Eighty Fed, Coffee Club, both 77 Convenience stores and News Agency store. Standby for presence.
Heading towards Wyndham St via Federal St.
Standby at corner of Wyndham and Albert St; welfare check on Cathedral Church all clear. Standby for presence.
Albert Mart all clear. Continuing towards Lower Albert.
Arrived at Lower Albert; standby at Commercial Bay for presence.
No issues at Commercial Bay. Heading to Gore St.
Gore St all clear; standby at Auckland Harbour Suites.
No issues at Auckland Harbour Suites.
Full sweep Fort St; welfare check Chargrill, Jo & Joe's, Evan's Kebabs and KFC, no issues. Patrolling up High St.
High St all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St, all clear.
Checking in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear. Patrolling up Albert St towards 77 Convenience store.
Check-in 77 Convenience store and Coffee Club, no issues.
Response call to Banh Mi shop: vagrant blocking the entrance and scaring customers.
Arrived on site; kindly asked the vagrant to change locations, he complied, no further issues.
Full sweep Durham St, all clear.
Welfare checks Chemist Warehouse, Kathmandu and Macpac, no issues.
Response call from Queen St Macca's: individual sleeping inside the premises.
Arrived on site; asked the individual to leave. He tried arguing with us, then left the premises at 11:16, no further issues.
Welfare checks Look Sharp, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear.
Full sweep St Patrick's Cathedral Square, all clear.
Full sweep Federal St, all clear.
Responded to a call from Hotel Debrett: individual outside with drugs on the table.
Arrived on site; asked the individual to leave, he complied, no further issues.
Check-in Freyberg / Chancery Square; standby showing presence.
No issues at Chancery Square / Freyberg. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone (2%).
Arrived at HQ charging Ops Phone (1%).
Response call from Foot Locker: a group of individuals stealing, seen running off towards Lorne St.

Full swept Lorne St, Queens Arcade, Queen St and Britomart train station — could not find the POIs. While searching, removed vagrants from the Unichem entrance. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone.
Break ended; morning shift concluded, handover complete.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:50 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Standing by charging Ops Phone and waiting for response calls.
Commencing patrols for upper Queen Street areas.
Full sweep Darby Street and Elliott Street.
Arriving at Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Aotea complete; crossing over to Lorne Street for full sweep.
Sweep Rutland Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Lorne Street, all clear, no issues.
Sweep Victoria Street West, all clear, no issues.
Sweep Albert Street, all clear, no issues.
Sweep Federal Street. Heading towards Queen Street and maintaining visible presence.
Commencing patrols for Lower Queen Street areas.
Sweep Victoria St West heading down to Queen Street; maintaining presence and waiting for response calls.
Received a response call from Metropolis Hotel security requesting assistance for two residents fighting in the lobby and making a scene. Making our way over to Metropolis now.
Arrived at Metropolis Hotel; briefed with the security guard — the two residents were a couple and both went back upstairs to their room. Standby maintaining presence.
Commencing patrols from Metropolis Hotel down Victoria St East.
Full sweep High Street and Vulcan Lane.
Full sweep Fort St and Fort Lane.
Sweep Customs Street East; arrived Commercial Bay area, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, no issues.
Full sweep Lower Albert Street. Walking down to Queen Street through Victoria Street West.
Sweep Queen Street and Wyndham Street; welfare check on Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare checks completed on stores, areas and businesses:
Standing by on Queen Street maintaining visible presence and waiting for response calls.
Heading back to Headquarters for floor checks.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing floor checks.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed.
Heading back down to ground floor to commence patrols on upper street areas.
Sweep Victoria Street East/West, all clear, no issues.
Doing one final patrol route for upper Queen Street areas.
Sweep Albert Street, all clear, no issues.
Darby Street and Elliott Street sweep completed.

Welfare checks completed on Localito, Queen St McDonald's, Elliott Stables, Victoria Street Convenience store and Albert Street Convenience store. Walking down Wellesley Street West; standby on Queen St awaiting response calls.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging Ops Phone and standing by for calls.
Starting our 30-minute break and standing by for calls.
Afternoon shift completed; equipment handover completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Suiting up to start patrols. Commencing patrols on Lower Queen Street.
Arrived at Durham St West; no issues seen. Continuing down Queen Street.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; sweep conducted, no issues. Moving along en route.
Shortland Street and Fort Street all clear; low volume of civilians at this time. Continuing towards TK Square.
Arrived at TK Square; commencing sweep and a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart.
Sweep completed. Spotted a few vagrants in the area looking for shelter. McDonald's staff had no issues to relay. Heading back up through Fort Lane.
Fort Lane all clear. Moving along up High Street towards Chancery Square.
Arrived at Chancery Square; commencing sweep.
Chancery Square all clear. Standby due to higher volume of civilians than Queen Street.
All clear; no response calls. Continuing patrols up High Street.
Victoria St East all clear. Moving on towards Lorne Street.
Lorne Street all clear. Continuing towards Central City Library for a sweep.
Central City Library all clear; vagrants sleeping outside the library, otherwise no concerns. Cutting through Rutland Street towards Aotea for a sweep.
Arrived at Aotea Square; area busier than usual. Conducting sweep.
Area all clear despite high volume. Standby awaiting response calls.
No issues to report. Continuing down towards the Civic.
Arrived at the Civic; standby awaiting response calls before continuing en route.
All clear. Continuing down Queen Street.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street for a welfare check. Staff had reported a vagrant coming inside standing around customers; male was not present at time of arrival. Standby to show presence.
No sign of the male vagrant; area all clear. Staff advised to call if he returns. Heading down Darby Street.
Darby Street all clear; ensured safety of staff who had an event earlier, no reports of trouble. Continuing towards Elliott Street.
Elliott Street all clear, Atrium included. Heading up towards Albert Street through Wellesley Street West.
Albert Street all clear; low foot traffic. Continuing down Victoria Street West towards Queen Street.
Back on Queen Street; heading to HQ for floor checks. Commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Heading back out on patrol.
Full sweep Durham St, all clear.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear.
Welfare checks Albert St Convenience store, no issues.
Welfare check Marina guards, no issues.
Standby outside Andrew Andrew's due to a hospo party, showing presence.
No issues at Andrew Andrew's / Providor.
Full sweep Quay St, all clear.
Check-in Britomart Macca's / Commercial Bay, all clear.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St, all clear.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear.
Check-in Queen St Macca's, no issues. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone (10%).
Heading back out on patrols; heading up Victoria St, all clear.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear.
Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues.
Check-in Britomart Macca's / Commercial Bay, all clear.
Check-in Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Check-in Chancery Square / Freyberg, no issues. Heading back to HQ awaiting changeover.
